intent_text: Execute T05 local J2 contact/separation FEA on the frozen final C2R1 P003/P007 geometry. Run 200 and 300 N preload per screw, seal-reaction sensitivity 0/300/600 N, +0.20 bar pressure, no-penetration metal contact, local mesh <=0.20 mm at fastener/gland/pilot/flange-root regions, then refine the critical case. Report P003/P007 von Mises stress, maximum face separation, contact pressure, bolt axial force and J2 datum-face displacement. Do not mutate CAD geometry. If LC2 with 600 N seal reaction passes, retain OD33; otherwise trigger local J2 redesign.
